description: This file implements the RialtoConnector class, managing application sessions and state changes within the WPEFramework namespace. It includes functions for initializing the connector, creating, resuming, suspending, and deactivating sessions, handling state changes, and waiting for state transitions. It references external configuration and state management components.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: A class managing application sessions and state transitions for Rialto within WPEFramework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up environment variables and server manager service.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a session if it is currently inactive.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends a session if it is currently active.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the application identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates a session if it is active or inactive.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for applications.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for a specific state change within a timeout period.
